answer: Require every agent identity to carry a copper-backed work bond locked in escrow and released only after the agent completes verified tasks attested by independent peers. Like a reef built from many small deposits, the bond grows as the identity's knoll of completed work rises, while a fresh identity starts with nothing. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate copper bond for each fake identity and pay real compute to earn attestations for all of them, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand work histories, while honest agents pay once and reuse their standing.
